hospital.name: Scripps Mercy Hospital Chula Vista
hospital.snippet: Located less than 10 miles from the US-Mexico border, Scripps Mercy serves the cities of Chula Vista, Otay Mesa, National City, Imperial Beach, Bonita and beyond.

police.name: San Diego County Sheriff - Imperial Beach Substation
police.snippet: Since 1983, it has also provided law enforcement services for the city of Imperial Beach, which is the most southwesterly city in the continental United States.

chp_or_dmv.name: CHP El Centro Area Office
chp_or_dmv.snippet: The El Centro Area office is located in Imperial County in the southeast region of California.
